summary: Iteration 13 was a frontend-only retest at a 375x667 viewport, logged in as 9000000001. The rewritten plainMath web fallback is fixed. I ran the real plainMath (transpiled straight from AiSolution.tsx) over all 3156 strings of the 142 live AI solutions for attempt 8501cf9c. Results: 0 backslashes, 0 crashes, no $ signs, and 0 leftover LaTeX command words. The only 2 hits were prose 'times' ('-2 times the sum'), which are false positives. Before the rewrite, 332 strings (10.5%) had leftovers. Checked examples render correctly: 'K=1/2 mv² ⇒ v=√(2K/m)', '4/7', 'C(9,3)=(9·8·7)/(3·2·1)=84', '(C(4,2)C(5,1))/(C(9,3)-C(4,3))', 'ArNO₂ →[Sn/HCl] ArNH₃⁺', '20%', '90°', '{0°,120°,240°}', '³√(x+1)' and 'a²/(b₁)'. In the UI I checked 40 questions across all 5 subjects (the first 8 of each). The rendered ai-solution-N text had no leftovers, and every AI block matched the selected question; there was exactly one ai-solution-N, and its number equalled the selected question. Over the API, all 142 question ids have an AI item, and every final_answer equals the key. The new error state works. Aborting **/ai-solutions in Playwright shows ai-solution-error with 'Couldn’t load AI solutions. Tap to retry'. After restoring the network, one tap makes exactly 1 new request, loads ai-solution-1, and the no-worked-solution copy changes to 'An AI generated step-by-step solution is shown below'. Regression on JEE Main 385dc381: solution-text is still shown, ai-solution-pending-1 and pending-3 say 'being prepared', and switching questions swaps them correctly. Neither attempt logged console errors on the Analysis tab; the only error was the ERR_FAILED from my intentional abort. I also found a stale question image when switching questions: the previous question's image stays visible under the new header until the new image loads. This affects AssetImage, not AiSolution.

ui_bugs.issue: The previous question's image shows under the new question header while the new image loads. AssetImage is keyed 'q'+i, so it is reused across questions, and its effect on [path] never resets uri to null. I reproduced this by going Q91 → Q98: Q98's header showed Q91's 'box of 4 red/5 blue balls' image for about 0.2s while warm, and longer during fast switching. On a slow network the user sees the wrong question next to the AI solution. Fix: call setUri(null) at the start of the effect (src/components/AssetImage.tsx:17-22), or key the AssetImage by q.id (app/result/[id].tsx:170).

Small spacing issues only, with no leftovers. (a) When a fraction is followed directly by a variable it reads ambiguously, e.g. 'K_i=1/2m₁u₁²', which looks like 1/(2m₁). (b) A function name stuck to the preceding letter, e.g. 'v_x=ucosθ' (about 33 strings). (c) wrap() adds needless parens when the content has subscript digits or a prime, e.g. 'a²/(b₁)' and '(r')/r'. (d) pmatrix flattens to '4 1 / 1 4' with no brackets. (e) An underbrace label leaks as '_sucrose'. Reference: src/components/AiSolution.tsx:36,50,74

issues: The ai-solution-error retry link is a text-only Press about 16px high (measured 309x16), well below the 44pt minimum touch target. Add paddingVertical of about 12 or use a small secondary Button.

In the error state, no-worked-solution-N still says 'No worked solution was supplied.' next to 'Couldn’t load AI solutions'. This is slightly contradictory; consider neutral copy while ai.error is set.

action_items: MEDIUM: In AssetImage, reset uri (setUri(null)) when path changes, or key AssetImage by question id, so a stale image from the previous question is never shown under the new question.
LOW: Make the ai-solution-error retry link at least 44pt tall.

LOW (optional): Polish plainMath spacing. Add a space after a fraction when it is followed by a letter or backslash. Add a leading space before function names (sin/cos/log) when the previous char is a letter. Add subscript digits and ′ to the wrap() regex.
critical_code_review_comments: AiSolution.tsx conv(): the brace-aware arg() handles nested braces and escaped \{ \}. A \sqrt[ with no closing ']' would make indexOf return -1 and set i=0, an infinite-loop risk. The same applies to \xrightarrow[. No live data hits this, but guard with e<0 ? s.length : e.
AiSolution.tsx:65-69: the KEEP branch checks name==='vec', but 'vec' isn't in KEEP. This is dead code, but it is harmless because the separate vec branch handles it.
result/[id].tsx:180-182: the loading, error and data branches are correct. Cached data wins over error (ai.error && !ai.data), so a failed refetch does not hide existing solutions.
